description: List your recent and active picture generations: queued batches and the pictures generate_image made right in the chat. Returns counts per status (pending / running / completed / failed) plus an array with id, status, prompts, model, ref counts, scheduledAt, finishedAt. Videos are in list_my_videos and audio takes in list_my_audio.

status.description: "all" for everything, or an array like ["pending","running"]. Default: active + recent.
